verdict.rationale: The only recurring capability in the evidence is Paystack's collection of recurring payments, which is billing for customers, not a general facility for users to schedule their own jobs or workflows. Nothing documents a scheduler, cron-like triggers, or workflow automation, so this adjacent payment feature earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Collect one-time and recurring payments from your app or website
